document_structure.content:
Template ID | FIN-PN-001
Category | Promissory notes & IOUs
Intended use | Unconditional written promise to pay a specified sum, subject to applicable formalities.

DRAFTING PLACEHOLDERS: Replace every {{...}} field, delete unused options, complete all schedules, and resolve all [SELECT]/[OPTIONAL] text before signature. Text in square brackets is an instruction, not an agreed term.
This PROMISSORY NOTE (the “Agreement”) is made on {EFFECTIVE_DATE} (the “Effective Date”) by and between {{PARTY_A_LEGAL_NAME}} and {{PARTY_B_LEGAL_NAME}}.
Each may be referred to as a “Party” and together as the “Parties”. The legal names, entity types, registration details and notice addresses of the Parties are set out below.

content.content:
Party A | {{PARTY_A_LEGAL_NAME}}; {{ENTITY_TYPE}}; registration no. {{REGISTRATION_NUMBER}}; address {{REGISTERED_ADDRESS}}; email {{NOTICE_EMAIL}}
Party B | {{PARTY_B_LEGAL_NAME}}; {{ENTITY_TYPE}}; registration no. {{REGISTRATION_NUMBER}}; address {{REGISTERED_ADDRESS}}; email {{NOTICE_EMAIL}}

document_structure.heading: BACKGROUND
content: A. The Parties wish to enter into the financial arrangement described in this Agreement.
B. Each Party confirms that it has authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, subject to the terms below.

document_structure.heading: 1. PROMISE TO PAY
content: For value received, {{MAKER_LEGAL_NAME}} (the “Maker”) unconditionally promises to pay to the order of {{PAYEE_LEGAL_NAME}} (the “Payee”) the principal sum of {{CURRENCY}} {{PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT}} on or before {{MATURITY_DATE}}, together with interest as stated below.

document_structure.heading: 2. INTEREST
content: The unpaid principal shall bear interest at {{INTEREST_RATE}} per annum from {{INTEREST_START_DATE}} until paid, calculated on {{DAY_COUNT_BASIS}}. If no interest is intended, state “0%” and confirm that treatment is lawful.

document_structure.heading: 3. PAYMENT
content: Payment shall be made in immediately available funds to {{PAYEE_PAYMENT_DETAILS}} without set-off except as required by mandatory law. The payment schedule, if instalments apply, is attached as Schedule A.

document_structure.heading: 4. PREPAYMENT
content: Maker may prepay all or part of the outstanding amount at any time {{WITHOUT_PREPAYMENT_FEE / ON THE FOLLOWING TERMS: ...}}. Any payment shall be applied first to lawful costs, then accrued interest, then principal, unless mandatory law requires otherwise.

document_structure.heading: 5. LATE PAYMENT
content: Any amount unpaid after its due date may attract {{LATE_CHARGE_OR_DEFAULT_INTEREST}} only to the extent lawful and expressly agreed. No amount in this Note authorises a charge exceeding a mandatory legal limit.

document_structure.heading: 6. WAIVERS AND PRESENTMENT
content: [OPTIONAL — use only after legal review: Maker waives presentment, demand and notice of dishonour to the extent such waiver is legally effective. No waiver limits rights that cannot lawfully be waived.]

document_structure.heading: 7. NO VARIATION EXCEPT WRITING
content: Any extension, waiver or amendment must be in writing and signed by Maker and Payee. A delay in enforcing this Note is not a waiver.

document_structure.heading: 8. GOVERNING LAW AND FORUM
content: This Note is governed by {{GOVERNING_JURISDICTION}}. Disputes shall be brought before {{COURT_VENUE}} [or resolved by {{ARBITRATION_MECHANISM}} if legally suitable].

document_structure.heading: SIGNATURES
content: The Parties have caused this Agreement to be executed by their duly authorised representatives as of the dates set out below.

content.content:
MAKER |  | By: ______________________________ | Name: {SIGNATORY_NAME} | Title: {SIGNATORY_TITLE} | Date: {SIGNATURE_DATE} | Witness (if required): __________________ | Name: {{WITNESS_NAME}} | Date: {{WITNESS_DATE}}
PAYEE (ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, IF REQUIRED) |  | By: ______________________________ | Name: {SIGNATORY_NAME} | Title: {SIGNATORY_TITLE} | Date: {SIGNATURE_DATE} | Witness (if required): __________________ | Name: {{WITNESS_NAME}} | Date: {{WITNESS_DATE}}

statutory_verification.heading: CLAUSECITE STATUTORY VERIFICATION — INTERNAL DRAFTER NOTES
content: Do not present these prompts as legal citations. Use the selected jurisdiction, transaction facts and current statutory corpus to retrieve and validate the applicable provisions. Insert verified citations into the relevant clauses only after retrieval.
Check the selected jurisdiction’s legal requirements for negotiable instruments / promissory notes, including form, signature, stamping and enforceability.
Verify limitation periods, interest restrictions and any mandatory consumer or lending disclosures.

generation_policy.unresolved_placeholder_behavior: Ask the user or leave an explicit drafting issue; never silently fill.
generation_policy.conditional_text_behavior: Resolve [OPTIONAL], [SELECT], and [DELETE IF NOT USED] instructions before rendering; retain unresolved items as drafting blockers.
generation_policy.jurisdiction_citations: Retrieve from the jurisdiction-specific legal corpus; never fabricate statutes, sections, quotations, or citations.
